observation.command:
cd /workspace && mkdir -p biletado && cd biletado
# generate secrets
CS=$(openssl rand -hex 16); JS=$(openssl rand -hex 64); JRS=$(openssl rand -hex 64)
cat > .env <<EOF
PORT=8081
LOG_LEVEL=info
NODE_ENV=production
FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:8080
BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8081
DB_URL=mongodb://mongodb:27017/booking-manager
DB_NAME=booking-manager
CRYPTO_SECRET=$CS
JWT_SECRET=$JS
JWT_REFRESH_SECRET=$JRS
JWT_ALGORITHM=HS512
JWT_EXPIRES_IN=15m
JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN=7d
JWT_ISSUER=smart-city-booking
JWT_AUDIENCE=smart-city-api
INIT_ADMIN=admin
INIT_ADMIN_SECRET=admin
DISABLE_EMAIL_CHECK=true
RULE_ENGINE_ENABLED=false
EOF
cat > docker-compose.yml <<'EOF'
services:
  mongodb:
    image: mongo:7
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - mongodb_data:/data/db
    networks:
      - shared-net
  backend:
    build:
      context: ../smart-city-booking-backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: smart-city-booking-backend:local
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      PORT: "8081"
    depends_on:
      - mongodb
    ports:
      - "8081:8081"
    networks:
      - shared-net
networks:
  shared-net:
    external: true
volumes:
  mongodb_data:
EOF
echo "files written"; ls -la
